channel.title: Georgia Public Broadcasting - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Georgia Public Broadcasting (gpb.org)

item.title: President Trump delivers his first State of the Union address of his second term
item.description: While Trump spent much of his speech celebrating his first year in office, he also announced policies he wants to put into place.

item.title: Trump's speech is longest State of the Union address in recent history
item.description: Speaking for approximately one hour and 48 minutes, President Trump beat his previous record for longest speech given to a joint session of Congress.

item.title: Trump cheers Republicans, scolds Democrats in State of the Union address
item.description: Trump's speech is delivered before an intensely divided public. The president's policies and actions in the first year of his second term have reinforced those divisions.

item.title: Democratic Gov. Abigail Spanberger delivers response to Trump's State of the Union
item.description: NPR Analysts discuss newly sworn in Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger's Democratic response to President Trump's State of the Union address.

item.title: Trump honors gold medal-winning men's hockey team at State of the Union amid controversy
item.description: The celebration of the men's team comes after FBI Director Kash Patel's trip to the Games in Milan, and the president's comments about the U.S. women's team, have drawn scrutiny.

item.title: Read NPR's annotated fact check of President Trump's State of the Union
item.description: As President Trump delivered his State of the Union address, reporters from across NPR's newsroom, are fact checking his speech and offer context.

item.title: Read Trump's 2026 State of the Union address
item.description: Read President Trump's State of the Union delivered on Feb. 24.

item.title: Trump cheered himself and Republicans while scolding Democrats in State of the Union
item.description: Focusing on political victories during his State of the Union address, Trump gave himself and Republicans high marks while scolding Democrats for their stances on the economy and immigration.

item.title: Signs, silence, and skipping: How Democrats protested Trump's State of the Union
item.description: The pushback comes as Democrats enter a midterm year where they hope to make gains in the House and Senate.

item.title: China restricts exports to 40 Japanese entities with ties to military
item.description: China on Tuesday restricted exports to 40 Japanese entities it says are contributing to Japan's "remilitarization," in the latest escalation of tensions with Tokyo.
